description: Source code implementing validation lint rules for Kubernetes, including checks for alpha/beta tags, stability levels, and required/optional validation tags.

methods.name: checkAlphaBetaUsage
methods.description: Checks correct usage of +k8s:alpha and +k8s:beta tags within validation tags.

methods.name: alphaBetaPrefix
methods.description: Enforces that +k8s:alpha and +k8s:beta tags are used as prefixes.

methods.name: checkTagStability
methods.description: Recursively checks that tags meet the stability level requirements.

methods.name: validationStability
methods.description: Enforces stability level constraints on tags.

methods.name: hasTag
methods.description: Recursively checks if a specific tag exists within a tag tree.

methods.name: hasAnyValidationTag
methods.description: Checks if tags contain any registered validation tags.

methods.name: requiredAndOptional
methods.description: Ensures fields with validation have explicit +k8s:optional, +k8s:required, or +k8s:forbidden tags.

methods.name: lintRules
methods.description: Returns the list of lint rules including alphaBetaPrefix, validationStability, and requiredAndOptional.
